references.text: Describes the ashes of the red heifer to be used for the water of cleansing mentioned in verse 12
Repeats the instruction for cleansing on the third and seventh days, following the same pattern as in verse 12
Application of the cleansing rule on the third and seventh day for those who had killed someone in war
Cleansing process on the seventh day for lepers, showing a similar cleansing pattern
Cleansing after seven days for uncleanness, parallel to the seven-day period in Num 19:12
The book of Hebrews refers to cleansing with the ashes of the heifer and contrasts it with Christ's blood that cleanses the conscience
The consequence of not cleansing as described in verse 12 - the person remains unclean and defiles the tabernacle
